notADemo.title: That file is not a demo.
notADemo.hint: A match demo ends in .dem and comes from your match history. Check the file and try again.

truncated.title: This demo is incomplete.
truncated.hint: The recording stops part-way through. Download it again and open the new copy.

unsupportedVersion.title: This demo is from an older game.
unsupportedVersion.hint: Only Counter-Strike 2 demos can be read. A CS:GO recording uses a format this tool does not open.

unsupportedContainer.title: This file is compressed in a format that cannot be opened.
unsupportedContainer.hint: Extract the archive first, then open the .dem inside it.

povDemo.title: This is a POV demo.
povDemo.hint: Only match demos (GOTV) carry data for all ten players. Download the match demo from your match history and try again.

malformed.title: This demo could not be read.
malformed.hint: The file is a Counter-Strike 2 demo, but the recording is damaged. Try another copy of it.
